methods.annual_aggregation: Weight each month by its calendar days. Require 12 valid months per year.
methods.regression: Ordinary least squares with intercept, using calendar decades.
methods.conventional: Student t inference assumes independent, constant-variance errors.
methods.hac: Newey–West HAC uses Bartlett weights, floor(4 × (n/100)^(2/9)) calendar-year lags, and n/(n−2) covariance correction. The Student t reference is approximate.
methods.grid_check: Identify a unique native grid cell by an exact match of all 12 calendar-month values against the NASA POWER regional 2023 response. Nominal nearest centers, record identity and request proximity provide additional duplicate screening.

limitations: Grid estimates can combine land and sea and can miss neighborhood-scale conditions.
Locations may have spatially correlated errors, even when their series differ.
A linear fit can miss changes in rate, extremes, and seasonal patterns. Shorter windows typically have less statistical power.
The displayed inference is conditional on each period and method. The related windows are descriptive sensitivity checks and are not adjusted for multiple comparisons.
Intervals represent regression uncertainty and exclude reanalysis uncertainty. The analysis cannot establish what caused the change.
